query:
The Champions League has entered the semi-final stage: the Bei team of Spain's first-class Football League is against the Qi team of the British Premier League, and the Ba team of Spain's first-class Football League is against the Qie team of Germany's first-class Football League. Before the game, Joe predicted that the champion can only be produced in the two teams of Spain's first-class Football League; Xiao Zhou predicted that Bei and Qi could only win the runner up at most. After the game, it proved that their predictions were incorrect.

A team of the British Premier League won the championship.

repl_history.response: The [Global Context Preview] contains sufficient information to deduce that the prediction made by Xiao Zhou (which said "Bei and Qi could only win the runner up at most") was broken when teams outside of Spain's football league won, although this particular instance is from the British Premier League rather than one of Xiao Zhou's stipulated options.
